peligro.detalle: Deleting your account removes your user and your access to every brand. This can't be undone.

eliminar.vasAEliminar: You're about to delete the account {email}. This can't be undone:

consecuencias.acceso: your user and your access to every brand are deleted;
consecuencias.archivan: brands where you're the only member are archived: their networks are disconnected and their scheduled posts are canceled;
consecuencias.historial: in the brands' history, your name becomes “Deleted account”.

eliminar.recuperar: The content of archived brands is kept and can be recovered for 30 days by asking <link>{contacto}</link>.
eliminar.bloquean: You're the only owner of {n, plural, one {this brand} other {these brands}}, and there are other people in {n, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Before deleting your account, make someone else an owner in Team.
eliminar.personasMas: {n, plural, one {# more person} other {# more people}}

avisos.detalle: Notifications go to the brand's whole team, except whoever took the action. Choose which ones you want and where.
avisos.telefono: Phone notifications arrive if you have the app installed and allowed it to notify you.
